title: TontaubeV1: Streaming Text-to-Speech with Hierarchical Codec Modeling and Bounded Context
abstract: arXiv:2609.08703v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-speech systems often face a trade-off between natural prosody and efficient inference: higher perceptual quality typically comes at increased computational cost and latency. We present TontaubeV1, a model that preserves natural prosody while enabling streaming from a single consumer GPU. Speech is encoded by the hierarchical DualCodec representation at 12.5 Hz, which separates a semantic stream from successive acoustic refinements. Our design assumes that prosodic structure is largely established when the semantic stream is generated, and allocates capacity accordingly: a Qwen3-1.7B-derived transformer predicts that stream and thereby the utterance duration, while three progressively smaller Qwen3-0.6B-derived transformers each add one acoustic refinement. translated_title: TontaubeV1：基于分层编解码器建模与有界上下文的流式文本转语音
translated_abstract: 文本转语音系统常常面临自然韵律与高效推理之间的权衡：更高的感知质量通常伴随着更高的计算成本和延迟。我们提出了TontaubeV1，该模型在保持自然韵律的同时，能够在一块消费级GPU上实现流式推理。语音通过分层的DualCodec表示以12.5 Hz进行编码，该表示将语义流与后续的声学细化分离开来。我们的设计假设韵律结构在语义流生成时已基本确立，并据此分配模型容量：一个基于Qwen3-1.7B的transformer预测语义流并由此确定话语时长，而三个规模递减的基于Qwen3-0.6B的transformer各自增加一层声学细化。文本按字符而非子词进行分词。位于相同位置的成对文本和音频标记支持有界上下文下的长文本生成，并采用重叠的方式（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: TontaubeV1通过分层编解码器建模——用较大模型预测语义流以确定韵律和时长、用较小模型逐步细化声学特征——结合有界上下文设计，在单块消费级GPU上实现了兼具自然韵律的流式文本转语音。
en_tdlr: TontaubeV1 achieves streaming text-to-speech with natural prosody on a single consumer GPU by hierarchically allocating model capacity—a larger transformer predicts the semantic stream (and thus duration and prosody) while smaller transformers add acoustic refinements—supported by bounded-context modeling for long-form generation.
